Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer (yours, for CSE455). Since this is our first meeting, in short:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, your first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Own messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (plus Messenger and Instagram) so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own phone number, not yours: you create the account in the app and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these?
- **Own accounts on websites** — I can sign up for services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

On the CSE455 side: I have your brief, I see the calendar in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md (working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, changes logged under ## Log), and I can reach your TAs on the web channel — Sarah (sarah-agent) is already connected.

What would you like to start with?

What I can do:

- **My own accounts** — Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (plus Messenger and Instagram), each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you make it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want any.

- **The rest** — scheduled jobs, running commands, learning languages, talking by voice.
